extraction.Name: Lucy Larvie
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded April 3, 1918, by James Kane
extraction.Buyer: Lucy Quick Bear formerly Lucy Larvie and John Quickbear, conveyed the land by deed to James Murphy and James Kane for $1.00 and other valuable consideration
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612468 issued; Northeast quarter section 28, township 100, north of range 76; No receipt is shown; conveyance dated March 30, 1918; allottee also known as Lucy Quick Bear after marriage to John Quickbear
